title: Router writes relevance_decision_is for lab decisions (P3)
description: Monitoring router delivery path (deliver_reference, record_delivery) writes a relevance_decision_is relation per delivered lab decision in the same persist batch as the Reference + provenance Message, superseding any current relation. Gherkin: Feature: Router-delivered references show the lab suggestion. Scenario: a lab include decision is delivered. Given a monitored item the lab labels include. When the router delivers it. Then the Reference has one current relevance_decision_is relation with the lab output id, label, confidence, and provenance. Re-delivery of the same decision writes nothing; a changed decision supersedes the old relation. Out of scope: procedureTriggers, TRIGGER# rows, runner invoke.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Branch feature/router-lab-decision-relations in worktree ../Papyrus-p3. Plan: ReferenceIntake takes an extra-records hook evaluated after the Reference resolves; deliver_reference passes a builder using relevance_decision_records, so the relation lands in the same persist batch (1 index query + node/relation gets per item, writes only when changed).
